name: RepoFetchAgent
description: Resolves the default branch and the commit SHA first (REST API, or git ref discovery when rate-limited), lists the commit's tree and fetches the selected files by SHA in parallel — authenticated with GITHUB_TOKEN (private repos the token can read) — with rate-limit-aware exponential backoff with jitter; falls back to the commit zip (selected members only, decompressed-size and member caps) when the tree API is unavailable or truncated; reports repo_coverage.

inputs.name: github_url
inputs.description: GitHub repository URL (public, or private when GITHUB_TOKEN can read it)

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch to evaluate; defaults to the repo's default branch

inputs.name: brd_path
inputs.description: User's BRD path or GitHub link — always fetched

outputs.name: repo_dir
outputs.description: Absolute path of the extracted repository root

outputs.name: repo_tree
outputs.description: Full list of file paths in the commit (from the tree or the zip)

outputs.name: commit_sha
outputs.description: Commit every file was fetched at (always resolved)

outputs.name: repo_coverage
outputs.description: source (tree|zip), files_in_tree, selected, fetched, skipped {reason: n}, failed_paths, truncated, truncation_reason, commit_sha, authenticated, private
